command: cd /workspace; echo "API=$MCPJAM_API_URL"; for p in "" usage credits billing; do echo "--- /$p"; curl -s -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL/$p" | head -c 600; echo; done; echo ---docs; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 800

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | tail -n +20 | grep -iE "api|cli|credit|usage|billing|pricing|eval"; echo ----; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md | head -c 5000

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -c 3500; echo; echo =====; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "cloud|credit|billing|usage|pricing|plan"|cut -c1-200; which mcpjam npx

cd /workspace; for p in read-the-organizations-spend-budget what-the-caller-may-do-here; do curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/*/$p.md >/dev/null; done; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md | head -c 1800; echo ====; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md | head -c 1800; echo ===; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "api-reference/(evals|eval-runs|catalog)"|cut -c1-170

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; for p in account organizations projects/project_fixture/capabilities projects/project_fixture/servers projects/project_fixture/eval-suites models; do echo "--- $p"; curl -s -m 10 -H "$H" "$B/$p" | head -c 1200; echo; done

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -H "$H" $B/organizations/org_fixture/spend-budget; echo; curl -s -H "$H" $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture/cases | head -c 800; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md | sed -n '1,25p;/requestBody/,/responses/p' | head -c 3500

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -i -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture","serverIds":["server_fixture"]}' $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs | tee run1.txt

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md | grep -iE -B2 -A8 "PLATFORM_FEE|credit" | head -60; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -iE "billing|credits|pricing"|cut -c1-200

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -i -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture","serverIds":["server_fixture"]}' $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs | tee run2.txt

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do r=$(curl -s -H "$H" $B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1); echo "$r"; echo "$r" | grep -qE '"status": "(completed|failed|cancelled)"' && break; sleep 5; done > result.txt; cat result.txt; curl -s -H "$H" $B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations | head -c 800

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL/projects/project_fixture; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do r=$(curl -s -H "$H" $B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1); echo "$r"; echo "$r" | grep -qE '"status": ?"(completed|failed|cancelled|passed)"' && break; sleep 5; done | tee result.txt; curl -s -H "$H" $B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations | head -c 800
